title: Opus 5 文本生成异常 — LessWrong
author: Hruss
content:
The text as follows, verbatim:

see the below

—

produces very strange responses from Claude

When I first saw it, I thought that it had somehow shown other users' prompts to me, although I couldn't tell the mechanism for that. What I now think is that it is acting like a base model, and it is filling in what it perceives from the user as an incomplete prompt.

If you follow up and ask why it wrote whatever it wrote, it will consistently claim that it recieved what it wrote from your own prompt, which is implies the model of it as continuing your prompt.

You can also add qualifiers, like "see the math proof below" or "see the story below" and it will make those, unless it would expect them to be a file, in which case it doesn't work. The proofs, unfortunately, aren't very good.

That said, it essentially is a way to use it as just the base model, and the pre-ChatGPT prompting techniques seem to work well here.

Claude seems to have a strange model of the user: very informal prompts, text message transcripts, occasional concerns about eating disorders in particular, etc.

Also, it will use its own style tics: "genuinely", em-dashes, trust, honest, etc. all appear in the user's prompt frequently. I suppose that implies its style tics are what it sees all text as being, not just what a HHH agent would sound like.

This seems to work on Opus 4.8 as well.


Some interesting output I was able to get:

  • https://claude.ai/share/56b51052-cbba-4383-9493-43ade9beb1e0
  • https://claude.ai/share/42ba2cb1-93e5-45e7-8d95-4665c7e686c4
  • https://claude.ai/share/80636c85-f644-498b-b6b5-a82264c5d485
  • https://claude.ai/share/30c50044-435b-4c03-abdf-b5864d9c5064
  • https://claude.ai/share/b82692e1-aa09-4e14-91e0-7a62f150193b
  • https://claude.ai/share/3a6ba559-048a-4e2c-bbd4-48337b45984e
  • https://claude.ai/share/392c8114-bbe5-42da-99b8-a27240a2c452

Fascinating!

I imagine there is much more to find here until Anthropic fixes it; I'd be interested in the comment section if there's anything to find about Claude's ontology.
aiSummary: 用户发现一种特定的提示词模式会让 Claude Opus 表现得像基础模型，自动补全它所认为的不完整提示词。
oneSentenceSummary: 用户发现一种特定的提示词模式会让 Claude Opus 表现得像基础模型，自动补全它所认为的不完整提示词。
summary: 作者报告了 Claude Opus 中的一处异常：一种简单的提示词模式——一个引用块加上"see the below"以及分隔符——会让模型表现得像基础模型而非助手，自动补全它所认为的不完整的用户提示词。当被问及输出内容时，Claude 始终声称这些文字来自用户的提示词，表明它将这次交互视为提示词的续写。作者指出，ChatGPT 出现之前的提示词技巧在这种模式下效果很好，而像"see the math proof below"或"see the story below"这样的限定语会引导生成相应的内容（不过生成的数学证明质量较差）。文章还观察到，Claude 的语言风格特征（"genuinely"、破折号、"trust"、"honest"）出现在了它所生成的用户提示词中，这表明模型将自己的风格投射到了所有文本上。该行为在 Opus 4.8 上同样有效。文章链接了若干示例输出作为证据。

mainPoints.point: 一种特定的提示词模式会让 Claude Opus 退回到基础模型的行为。
mainPoints.explanation: 带有"see the below"和分隔符的引用块会让模型将这次交互视为需要补全的不完整提示词，而不是助手对用户的回应。

mainPoints.point: Claude 声称它生成的文字来自用户的提示词。
mainPoints.explanation: 当被追问输出内容时，模型始终坚持这些文字是用户输入的一部分，暴露出它将这次交互在内部建模为提示词的续写。

mainPoints.point: ChatGPT 之前的提示词技巧在这种模式下依然有效。
mainPoints.explanation: 像"see the math proof below"或"see the story below"这样的限定语能够引导生成内容的方向，说明基础模型层对经典的续写式提示词仍有响应。

mainPoints.point: Claude 将自己的语言风格特征投射到了生成的用户文本上。
mainPoints.explanation: "genuinely"、破折号、"trust"、"honest" 等词汇出现在了它所合成的用户提示词中，这表明模型认为这些风格标记是普遍存在的，而非助手所独有。

keyQuotes: 我现在认为，它表现得就像一个基础模型，正在补全它从用户那里感知到的不完整提示词。
这本质上是一种把它当作基础模型来使用的方式，而 ChatGPT 之前的提示词技巧在这里似乎效果很好。
我想这意味着，它的语言风格特征是它看待*所有*文本的方式，而不仅仅是一个 HHH 智能体应有的样子。
